body: There is no `--lsp` argument, where did you get that from? Also the language server does not start when running the project manager. Launching the editor without an `--path` argument opens the project manager. Launch Godot for the project you want to edit. If you want to use both the Godot editor and and neovim side by side it is also generally recommended to attach to the server running in the open editor and not launch another headless instance.
